note: Independent re-audit against RFC 4724 Section 4.1. Stage 2 -> Stage 5 startup race is fixed cleanly via subscribe-before-read and write-before-emit: emitSelectionDeferred calls ribevents.NoteSelectionDeferred(maxDelay) before emitting SelectionDeferred, emitSelectionComplete and selectionDeferral.stop call ribevents.ClearSelectionDeferred() before emitting SelectionComplete, and fibKernel.waitAndSweepStale reads ribevents.ActiveSelectionDeferral() immediately after subscribing to both events to seed initialDelay past active+fallbackDelay. TestRFC4724RestartingSpeakerForwardingState replicates the real Stage 2 -> Stage 5 order (NoteSelectionDeferred + emit BEFORE starting waitAndSweepStale), verifies no premature sweep past the 25ms fallback delay, proves processEvent updates forwarding state for 198.51.100.0/24 and adds 198.18.0.0/24, and proves ClearSelectionDeferred + SelectionComplete immediately sweeps unrefreshed stale 203.0.113.0/24 while preserving refreshed and fresh routes (negative).
